svg.title: VTR file structure
svg.desc: A file header is followed by append-only sections, then the DIRECTORY section and the trailer. Each section carries its own 24-byte header and payload. Sizes are schematic, not byte scale.
svg.text: Sections are append-only; the directory and trailer are written last.
